clips.title: The story
paras: At Duskwood's central crossroads, Watcher Dodds keeps watch for the Night Watch. From his roadside outpost, he watches for danger and asks travelers to thin the giant spider population.

Watcher Dodds guards the crossroads for the Night Watch, under Commander Althea Ebonlocke. His post stands where the roads from Darkshire, Raven Hill, and Deadwind Pass meet. Darkshire's palisades shelter the town, but Dodds keeps watch beyond them, amid wolf packs, ravenous ghouls, and oversized spiders. From his roadside camp, he watches for threats and asks passing mercenaries to kill spiders emerging from the undergrowth before they overrun the roads.
